### 1 — Scene
A mixed-leaf salad with cucumber, dark olives, shaved hard cheese, and a few apparent croutons.

### 2 — Vessel
A shallow, oval dinner plate, approximately 28 × 24 cm. Using an equivalent circular diameter of **26 cm**:
**Area = 3.14 × 13² ≈ 530 cm².**

### 3 — Items
Mixed salad leaves, cucumber slices, dark olives, Parmesan-style cheese shavings, and croutons. No separate oil or dressing is clearly identifiable, so none is added.

### 4–7 — Area, volume, weight, and energy
Area shares allocate the overlapping salad ingredients across the plate.

| Item | Area share | Area × height = gross volume | Bulk density | Weight | kcal/100 g | Energy |
|---|---:|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Mixed leaves | 28% | 148 cm² × 2.5 cm = 370 ml | 0.15 | 56 g | 20 | 11 kcal |
| Cucumber | 28% | 148 cm² × 1.5 cm = 222 ml | 0.65 | 145 g | 15 | 22 kcal |
| Dark olives | 12% | 64 cm² × 1.5 cm = 96 ml | 0.65 | 62 g | 145 | 90 kcal |
| Hard cheese shavings | 13% | 69 cm² × 0.65 cm = 45 ml | 0.95 | 43 g | 400 | 172 kcal |
| Croutons | 4% | 21 cm² × 1 cm = 21 ml | 0.90 | 19 g | 400 | 76 kcal |
| **Total** | **85%** | | | **425 g** | | **371 kcal** |

### 8 — Sanity check
About **425 g and 370 kcal** is plausible for this mostly covered dinner plate: cucumber supplies substantial weight, while the cheese and olives supply most of the energy. The croutons are a small portion. Any dressing that cannot be distinguished in the photo would increase the energy estimate.
